semantic_event_mapping.DAMAGE: native DAMAGE event records one hit and consumed projectile
semantic_event_mapping.DESTROY: native DESTROY event records target removal after lethal DAMAGE

assumptions: Diagonal move vector is normalized to unit magnitude per tick.
Projectile collision uses radius 4; the first matching enemy in array order receives one hit.
Projectiles are checked for overlap before their next movement; each consumed projectile damages at most one target.
Projectiles move upward 4 units per tick and spawn 3 units above the player.
Held fire cooldown is 10 simulation ticks.
Source and usage budgets are unverified.
